# Door style photos

Product photos of each door style (flat panel, and `-raised` for the raised panel version), from the
door maker's website (eaglewoodworking.com, door style pages, Nov 15, 2026), cropped and shrunk to
900 px. Published next to the page as `doors/<style>.webp`; the customer drawing set's door style
sheet shows the one for the job, embedded in the file when the set is downloaded or sent.
